title: Microsoft PC Manager SAS Token Incorrect Permission Assignment Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on Microsoft PC Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the permissions granted to an SAS token. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to launch a supply-chain attack and execute arbitrary code on customers' endpoints.
